subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.binary@raw` is this plugin's own self-contained raw binary blob — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, splice, append-bytes, truncate-at, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
